verdict.rationale: Publishing bulk public-data extracts is a fair question for a state revenue agency, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive lookups (a business lookup, a sales and use tax rate finder, a list of B&O rates). Nothing documents downloadable datasets, registry extracts, or statistics files, and probes found no API or machine-readable endpoints.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
